_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
We uyu ni Mcheza {player_id}, ukuchezera {num_rounds} mizinga ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Una ${pool} kugawanya kweni mzingo huu kati yako na Mcheza {other_id}.

Mlembi woyipa:
  - Tengere chilango: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ikiikaribishwa → Upe $(pool - X), mcheza mwingine ape $X
  - Ikiikakataliwa → Wote wapate $0
  - Mfano: [Offer: $3]  au  'Nafikiri hii ni ya haki. [Offer: $5]'

Mlembi azitete:
  - Amue kuhusu chilango kwa [Accept] au [Reject]
  - Mfano: 'Inaonekana kuwa ya busara. [Accept]'
            'Ni ya kudhuru sana. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mzingo {round_number} unatangulia! ---
Mcheza {proposer_id} ni mlembi woyipa, Mcheza {responder_id} ni mlembi azitete.
round.accepted: Mcheza {responder_id} ikaribishwa! Mzingo {round_number} unapata: Mcheza {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mcheza {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Jumla mpya: Mcheza 0: ${total_0}, Mcheza 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mchezaji {responder_id} amekataa mapendekezo! Raundi {round_number} faida: Wote wanapata $0. Jumla zinabaki: Mchezaji 0: ${total_0}, Mchezaji 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Mchezaji anayetoa mapendekezo lazima atumie fomu [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Ndalama izo ŵapika zikwenera kuŵa zinandi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ndalama izo ŵapelekenge zikwenera kuŵa pakati pa $0 na ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Hakuna mapendekezo ya sasa ya kujibu.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Mchezaji anayejibu lazima atumie ama [Accept] au [Reject] kwa mapendekezo.

outcome.win: Mcheza {winner} wina na ${winner_total} wosiyanasi na Mcheza {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Ŵakuchita maseŵera agha ŵakasanga ndalama zakukwana ${total}.
